title: Hector and Paris return
intro: Hector and Paris rejoin the fighting like a welcome wind for tired sailors. Athena and Apollo set out to meet each other.

notes.text: πύλη, gate: gen pl, epic -έων; ἐκσεύομαι, rush out: 3sg aor mid; φαίδιμος, gleaming / glorious.
τῷ, with him (demonstrative dat); ἅμα, together; κίε, 3sg impf of κίω, go; ἀδελφεός, brother (epic form).
θυμός, heart / spirit: “in their hearts”; μέμονα, be eager: 3pl perf with present sense + inf πολεμίζειν, μάχεσθαι.
ναύτης, sailor; ἐέλδομαι, long for: pres mid ptc dat pl; ἔδωκεν, 3sg aor of δίδωμι (gnomic: “gives”).
οὖρος, fair wind; κάμνω, grow weary: 3pl aor subj, general clause with κε.
εὔξεστος, well-polished: dat pl fem; ἐλάτη, fir tree, by metonymy an oar.
ἐλαύνω, drive / row: pres ptc nom pl; κάματος, toil / weariness: dat, with ὑπό “under, from”.
γυῖον, limb (pl); λύω, loosen: 3pl perf pass, “are unstrung.”
τώ, nom dual of ὁ, the two; φαίνομαι, appear: 3du aor pass; ἐελδομένοισι, to the longing Trojans.
αἱρέω, take / kill: 3du 2aor, unaugmented; ὃ μὲν (Paris) answered by Ἕκτωρ δέ in 11.
Ἀρηΐθοος, Areithous; ἄναξ, lord: gen sg with υἱόν; the son is Menesthius.
Ἄρνη, Arne: dat of place; ναιετάω, dwell: pres ptc acc sg.
κορυνήτης, club- / mace-bearer: nom sg, in apposition to Areithous.
γείνομαι, beget / bear: 3sg aor mid, elided; βοῶπις, ox-eyed: epithet of Phylomedusa.
Ἠϊονεύς, acc Ἠϊονῆα; βάλλω, strike: 3sg 2aor; ἔγχος, spear; ὀξυόεις, sharp: dat sg.
αὐχήν, neck; στεφάνη, helmet rim; εὔχαλκος, well-bronzed: gen sg; ὑπό + gen, beneath.
λύω, loosen: unaugmented 3pl aor mid with passive sense; formulaic death line, repeated in 16.
Ἱππόλοχος, Hippolochus: gen sg; πάϊς = παῖς, child; ἀγός, leader: of the Lycians, pl gen.
Ἴφινοος, Iphinous: acc; δόρυ, spear: dat sg δουρί.
κατά + acc, throughout; κρατερός, strong; ὑσμίνη, fight.
Δεξιάδης, son of Dexios: patronymic acc; ἐφάλλομαι, leap upon: 2aor mid ptc acc sg, syncopated.
ὠκύς, swift: gen pl fem, epic -άων.
ὦμος, shoulder: acc of the part struck; χαμάδις, to the ground; πέσε, πίπτω 3sg 2aor.
νοέω, perceive: 3sg aor; γλαυκῶπις, bright- / grey-eyed: epithet of Athena.
ὀλέκω, destroy: pres ptc acc pl, agreeing with Ἀργείους (here the Trojans are killing Greeks).
βαίνω, go: 3sg 2aor; κάρηνα, peaks: gen pl, κατά + gen, down from.
ἀΐσσω, dart / swoop: aor ptc nom fem sg.
Ἴλιος, Ilios; ἱερός, holy: fem acc sg.
τῇ, to meet her (dat fem); ἀντίος + dat, opposite; ὄρνυμι, rouse: mid 3sg, rose / set out.
Πέργαμος, Pergamos, Troy’s citadel: gen of place, “from”; ἐκκαθοράω, look down from: aor ptc nom sg.
βούλομαι, wish: 3sg impf; Τρώεσσι δὲ νίκην, he wanted victory for the Trojans.
